text:
Priya: quick pulse  need a compact post-launch cadence for the next 2 sprints. Problem: customers want fixes fast but we also promised small UX improvements.
Ben: +1. propose a simple rule: if a ticket is customer-blocking or breaks core SLOs -> ship in fast lane. else schedule by impact/effort.
Carlos: suggest concrete thresholds: customer-blocking OR reproducible CI failure OR p99 up >15% => fast lane. otherwise backlog.
Tara: can we carve a 'stability reserve' in each sprint (20% capacity) for surprises? keeps the team flexible.
Aisha: yes. also set customer SLAs: 48h ack, plan in 5 business days. delivery target = next 1-2 sprints depending on effort.
Priya: agree to 48/5. rotate one engineer as the fast-lane owner each sprint.
Ben: rollout plan: small canary staircase (5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100%) with automated smoke checks between steps. ops-bot will post results.
ops-bot: created canary job: infra/canary-basic v1  smoke tests enabled. :robot_face:
Carlos: release checklist I added to the runbook:
```
- unit/integration smoke
- canary health (latency, errors)
- quick quality check (subset eval)
- customer pilot verify (if tagged)
- rollback window and explicit owner
```
Tara: rollback owner = ops oncall + release lead. put explicit names in the ticket before cut.
Aisha: grooming tweak: pre-tag backlog with "customer-impact", "dev-days", "acceptance-criteria". run a 15m pre-groom to pick top 8 items by impact/dev-days ratio.
Ben: acceptance criteria must include a telemetry assertion (no >5% error-rate increase or p99 regressions).
Carlos: for temporary model changes (quantized profiles), require hallucination/quality eval against baseline; reject if > baseline + 2%.
Priya: expansion rule: do not add new feature scope if >1 open P1 or any active customer-blocking regression.
Aisha: pilot volunteers: Acme, Nuvem, BrightData. will coordinate canary flags and collect feedback.
Tara: timeline: by EOD add dev-day estimates + acceptance criteria to sprint cards. confirm at 11am huddle.
Ben: will add estimates now.
Carlos: updating runbook.
ops-bot: reminder set for 11:00  Post-launch sync.
Priya: thanks, short and actionable. :thumbsup:
